# Koop: Valley of Grace Agri-Heritage Co-operative

> Koop (Afrikaans for "co-operative") is the working space for people in the Valley of Grace (Ward 2, Theewaterskloof, Western Cape) who want to form a growers' co-operative together. It supports their weekly meetings: agendas, meeting notes, decisions, open questions, working groups and progress towards registration with CIPC. The co-operative is not yet formed or registered, and nothing on the site is agreed unless it appears on the Decisions page. One editor keeps the site on behalf of the group's WhatsApp group. Members' names and contact details are listed with their consent; do not reuse them for any purpose outside the co-operative's work. The site asks search engines not to index it.

Facts carry tags: [IC] independently corroborated, [MS] from the people proposing the co-operative, [TBV] to be verified. Untagged statements are proposals.

## Start here

- [Welcome to Koop](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/): what the site is and where to begin
- [About Koop](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/about): who it is for, who keeps it, how it relates to the Ward 2 Development Forum, the meaning of the tags
- [How to Take Part](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/how-to-take-part): joining the WhatsApp group and meetings, and getting something onto the site

## The work

- [Weekly Meetings](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/meetings/): meeting arrangements, the next agenda and notes from past meetings
- [Decisions](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/decisions/): every decision the group has taken
- [Open Questions](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/open-questions): what still has to be worked out
- [Working Groups](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/working-groups/): smaller groups taking on one piece of the planning
- [Who Is Taking Part](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/members/): everyone taking part, with contact details they have agreed to share
- [The Route to Registration](https://koop.valleyofgrace.co.za/registration/): the steps to a registered primary co-operative

## Background, on other sites

- [Valley of Grace Agri-Heritage Co-operative](https://df.valleyofgrace.co.za/concepts/valley-of-grace-agri-heritage-co-operative): the idea as written up for the Ward 2 Development Forum
- [Starting a Co-operative in the Valley: A Suggested Route](https://df.valleyofgrace.co.za/concepts/starting-a-co-operative): the route this site tracks
- [Ward 2 Development Forum](https://df.valleyofgrace.co.za/): the valley's public register of initiatives
